# Beatriz Porée

Beatriz Porée is the current Deputy of [District 6](https://flow.je/elections/district-6) and a member of [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). She was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Beatriz Porée has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/beatriz-poree#e20)

  Not elected.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/beatriz-poree-2/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J2F2ZpZswn4)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/beatriz-poree#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 6 with 38.6% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/beatriz-poree/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W7dt_JDBXmE)

Beatriz Porée has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 6](https://flow.je/elections/district-6), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/election/2026/04/09/st-helier-deputy-confirms-second-term-bid/)\]

**Beatriz Porée was not elected**.
